name: Hash Browns
desc: Crispy shredded potato and onion hash browns bound with egg and a little flour.

source.title: Emily's Famous Hash Browns
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list (2 medium russets, 1/2 onion, 1/4 cup flour, 1 egg, 1 cup oil) and the same rinse, squeeze and 1/2-inch-layer fry, read through a Punchfork copy because allrecipes.com blocked direct reads.

ingredients.raw: 2 medium russet potatoes (about 1 lb), peeled and shredded
1 cup vegetable or canola oil, for frying
Salt, black pepper, paprika, and cayenne, to taste, for finishing

steps: Shred the potatoes on the large holes of a box grater. Rinse in a colander until the water runs clear, then squeeze them dry in a clean kitchen towel.
In a bowl, mix the potatoes with the onion, flour, and egg until evenly combined.
Heat about 1/4 inch of oil in a large heavy skillet over medium-high heat until it sizzles when a shred of potato goes in.
Spread the potatoes in the pan in a 1/2-inch-thick layer. Cook undisturbed until deep golden brown on the bottom, about 5 minutes, then flip and brown the other side, about 5 minutes more.
Drain on paper towels, season with salt, pepper, paprika, and cayenne, and serve right away.
tips: Squeezing out the water is what makes them crisp; wet shreds steam instead of frying.
